tldr: Mercury in Gemini: the mind is quick, curious, and fluent in connection.
body: With Mercury in Gemini, Mercury is at home, so language, learning, questions, and exchange move naturally. You think by exploring options and linking one idea to the next.
gift: Wit, adaptability, communication skill, and the ability to translate complexity quickly.
challenge: Scattered attention, overtalking, and mistaking cleverness for depth.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
